answer: Proposal: each paid key reserves an exclusive 12-kW feeder slot at an orchard irrigation hub and locks 30 pearl credits. During a surprise simultaneous audit, the utility signs each meter’s 10-second load trace; proposed validators deny pay if a slot is reused or the trace is missing, and burn escrow for forged readings. A farm can wander between utilities and rent capacity, its cheapest attack, but each clone costs another live 12-kW slot for a season. Loans pay for separate non-poolable slots, not reuse of one; colluding utilities defeat this gate.
